result.instructions: Tools for fal.ai, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes fal.ai data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run falai_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run falai_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run falai_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. falai_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: falai_list_models
tools.title: List models
tools.description: List or search fal.ai models in the registry (paginated). fal.ai API: GET /models (query: keywords, page, total).

keywords.description: Optional search string to filter models by.

total.description: Page size (number of models per page).

tools.name: falai_get_model_schema
tools.title: Get model schema
tools.description: Get the OpenAPI 3 schema for a model — its input/output fields (components.schemas). Use this to learn what inputs a model accepts before submitting. fal.ai API: GET /openapi/queue/openapi.json?endpoint_id={model_id}.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

tools.name: falai_get_request_status
tools.title: Get request status
tools.description: Get the status of a queued request (IN_QUEUE | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED). fal.ai queue: GET {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/status (optional logs=1).

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

request_id.description: The queue request id returned when the request was submitted.

logs.description: Include queue logs in the response (?logs=1).

tools.name: falai_get_request_result
tools.title: Get request result
tools.description: Get the final output of a COMPLETED queued request. fal.ai queue: GET {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

request_id.description: The queue request id returned when the request was submitted.

tools.name: falai_submit_request
tools.title: Submit request
tools.description: Submit an inference request to the queue and return immediately (async — does NOT wait for completion). Returns { request_id, response_url, status_url, cancel_url, queue_position }. Consumes fal credits when the model runs. fal.ai queue: POST {queue}/{model_id} with body = the model input.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

input.description: The model's input object — arbitrary params for that model, e.g. { "prompt": "a cat" }. Use falai_get_model_schema to learn the fields.

tools.name: falai_run_model
tools.title: Run model (subscribe)
tools.description: Convenience 'subscribe': submit a request, poll its status until COMPLETED, then return the result. Consumes fal credits. If it does not complete within the wait budget, returns a { status, request_id, status_url, note } object (NOT an error) so you can keep polling with falai_get_request_status / falai_get_request_result.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

input.description: The model's input object — arbitrary params for that model, e.g. { "prompt": "a cat" }. Use falai_get_model_schema to learn the fields.

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for completion (default 60, capped at 300).

tools.name: falai_cancel_request
tools.title: Cancel request
tools.description: Request cancellation of a queued (not-yet-started) request. Returns 202 { status: 'CANCELLATION_REQUESTED' }. fal.ai queue: PUT {queue}/{model_id}/requests/{request_id}/cancel.

model_id.description: The fal.ai model id, used raw as a path segment, e.g. 'fal-ai/flux/schnell'.

request_id.description: The queue request id returned when the request was submitted.
